Indian Peacekeepers Honored with UN Medals in DR Congo

A contingent of 651 Indian Army peacekeepers has been awarded United Nations medals for their service in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The recognition highlights the Indian Army's ongoing contributions to international peacekeeping operations in conflict-affected regions. This award underscores the reputation and commitment of Indian soldiers serving under the UN flag.
